title: ASTROVITY
description:
CHALLENGING PUZZLE PLATFORMERAstrovity's challenging gravity-based movement system allows you to change the gravity in the room! Take in your surroundings and see how gravity can get you through each level by manipulating objects, doors and blocks around you!

A JOURNEY OF RECOVERYAstra is lost and alone after a dangerous space mission found your family lost in space! Help find Astra's parents on a mission throughout the galaxy! Traverse hundreds of handcrafted levels to save your family somewhere in this vast universe!

GRAVITYAstrovity has new mechanics in each chapter keeping the game fresh and interesting and allowing you to use gravity in new ways, chapter 1 introduces Gravity generators as well as Orange gravity Gems which need to be placed inside the generator to use whereas Chapter 4 introduces gravity doors and gravity sliding blocks which make traversing the hidden temple of ozmigone an interesting feat! there are many more interesting mechanics in between to keep you on your toes!

ASTROVITY• Single Player Story

• 200+ Puzzles

• Hardcore Levels 

• Local Multiplayer - MiniGames
